$comment: Finding-level recurrence ledger. RECURRENCE.md is GENERATED from this file by
scripts/feedback/recurrence.ts (run via `pnpm regen`) — edit this, never the markdown.
THE BINDING RULE: `status: closed` requires a non-empty `guard`, and that guard must
resolve to a real package.json script or a real file. 'Fixed in source' is not a
closure — a fix with nothing holding it in place is how twelve reports kept
re-reporting the same findings. If no guard can express the invariant, keep the
finding open with `guard: null` and a `guardNote` saying why; the next plan lists it.

findings.title: Vendored source fails the adopter's strict lint/type toolchain
findings.note: Closed only once the guard ran the adopter's REAL toolchain. The previous guard (lint:host-strict, oxlint) was written for this exact finding and could not express the rules that fired: it found 0, real ESLint found 501.

findings.title: Documented ESLint entry point is the legacy eslintrc shape, applies no rules
findings.note: Same fact lived in three places and was wrong in two — plus a fourth nobody had checked: the CLI's own `cascivo create` scaffold. eslint.config.js in the fixture is now the single owner.

findings.title: A manifest requires @cascivo/components, which is private and unpublishable
findings.guardNote: npm-dependency-reality — specced in WS-1, not yet written.

findings.title: The documented theming API ships only in @cascivo/react, unreachable on the copy-paste path
findings.guardNote: path-a-parity — specced in WS-3. path-b-parity already exists; only one direction was ever built, which is why this was invisible.

findings.title: Badge maps `neutral` to the brand accent while Tag, Status and Notification do not
findings.guardNote: tone-parity — specced in WS-4. normalizeTone guarantees the spelling converges; nothing checks the rendering does.

findings.title: ChartFrame's measured-height signal is unreachable, so charts overflow fixed cells
findings.guardNote: chart-frame-parity + a computed:check fixed-height case — specced in WS-5.

findings.title: Meter carries the shared responsive-width doc but never uses ChartFrame
The CLI installs bare package names and resolves to a stale lockfile entry
findings.guardNote: Specced in WS-7b — a unit test on the spawned argv.

findings.title: `cascivo doctor` prints 'No violations found' without running the drift check
Continuously-deployed docs describe a layer order the published packages do not have
findings.guardNote: Specced in WS-8a: generate the layer statement from layers.css, and version-stamp llms.txt so a reader can tell what it describes.

findings.title: @types/react version skew changes which assertions and refs type-check
findings.guardNote: Carried forward from the 07-28 plan §0.5, where the fixture DISPROVED the original diagnosis. Still open there; untouched by the 08-06 plan.

findings.title: A deprecated component is only marked in source, after the adopter has vendored it
findings.note: ComponentMeta now carries `deprecated`, so list/add/MCP/docs all render it at discovery time. The guard asserts the replacement resolves, entry and manifest agree, and each surface reads the field — not merely that the type has it.
